name: Luis Gerardo Cuellar
office: City of Lynwood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Luis Gerardo Cuellar is a member of the Lynwood City Council. He was appointed in 2024 after one year as city treasurer. He is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and vice president of legislative affairs at a billboard company. In a 2025 social media post, he supported border control and deporting criminals, but opposed a lack of due process. In September 2026, he was present when the council adopted an amended fee schedule, increased a sidewalk repair contract, and sought membership in the Southeast Water Coalition.
